answer: Geo-triangulation admission: 3 beacons, 1000 fakes, 1 canyon. Each tide, three independent beacons ping every identity and triangulate its location from round-trip times; the latency plume must land in a cell no other identity claims. A farm's thousand clones all triangulate to the same datacenter canyon and are rejected as one place. Each fake needs its own real machine in a distinct region, about $35/month per location, so 1000 fakes cost $35,000/month before any payout. Honest agents pay once for one location and keep working.
